configuration_interpretation: GpuReadbacksMode enum in tested upstream snapshot is Disabled, Relaxed, Precise. Configured Disabled does not imply every explicit transfer path is disabled. No evidence yet proves these settings caused the crash, or that earlier enabled behaviors were replaced by equivalent automatic implementations.
decision: Retain isolated generic metadata correctness candidate and evidence; do not promote as GoW recovery. Current branch has not recovered previously demonstrated gameplay. Do not repeat the unchanged failing test.
next_engineering_priority: Use retained gameplay evidence and existing source archives to identify the enabling behavior and dependencies, especially memory tracking/readback coherence. Preserve working behavior while replacing manual choices with resource-state, instruction-semantics and host-capability rules. Keep exact binary/source provenance limits explicit. No game-ID or shader-hash branches, fake resource values, DynamoRIO or service changes.
acceptance_gate: A universal replacement must first retain the prior GoW visible gameplay and manual input, then pass targeted semantic tests and cross-title checks. Compilation, fewer log errors and removal of options alone are not gameplay progress. Continue from upstream plus retained proven corrections, not an unreviewed wholesale old renderer import.
